origineel: Down comforters generally range from about $150 for value picks to $650 or more for premium goose-down models. Value options like Quince start near $150-$180, mid-range all-season comforters run roughly $250-$495, and luxury goose down from brands like Feathered Friends can reach $550-$650. Price tracks closely with fill power, fill type (goose costs more than duck) and construction. Buying during sales can bring premium models into the mid-range.
